title: Prune Gradually, Adapt Sparsely: Efficient Pruning of Large Language Models at Extreme Sparsity
abstract: arXiv:2610.41968v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Weight pruning can reduce the storage and inference cost of large language models (LLMs), but preserving quality at high sparsity levels remains challenging. Existing methods face a quality-cost trade-off in this regime. One-shot pruning is cheap but degrades sharply as sparsity increases, even when followed by post-pruning recovery. A growing line of work instead optimizes the mask directly from the dense model under the end-to-end objective; among these methods, [Lee et al.,2026], the recent state of the art at extreme sparsity, reaches high quality but at the cost of model-sized optimizer state and auxiliary variables. To address this gap, we propose ETAPS, which prunes gradually and adapts sparsely: it tightens a global sparsity constraint in progressive stages while training a sparse delta with a small, fixed budget. translated_title: 渐进剪枝，稀疏适配：大语言模型在极端稀疏度下的高效剪枝方法
translated_abstract: 权重剪枝可以降低大语言模型（LLM）的存储和推理成本，但在高稀疏度下保持模型质量仍然具有挑战性。现有方法在这种场景下面临质量与成本的权衡。一次性剪枝虽然成本低，但随着稀疏度的增加，即使进行剪枝后的恢复训练，质量也会急剧下降。越来越多的一类工作转而在端到端目标下直接从稠密模型优化剪枝掩码；在这些方法中，[Lee et al., 2026] 作为近期极端稀疏度下的最先进方法，达到了高质量，但其代价是需要与模型同等规模的优化器状态和辅助变量。为了填补这一空白，我们提出 ETAPS，其核心思想是渐进剪枝、稀疏适配：通过渐进式的阶段逐步收紧全局稀疏约束，同时以一个小的固定预算训练稀疏增量。我们的关键观察是，渐进式的权重移除使每个剪枝步骤足够小，从而让稀疏适配能够有效补偿质量损失……
tldr: ETAPS 通过渐进式收紧全局稀疏约束、并以小规模固定预算训练稀疏增量，在极端稀疏度下以远低于现有最优方法的内存开销实现大语言模型的高质量剪枝。
en_tdlr: ETAPS achieves high-quality pruning of LLMs at extreme sparsity with dramatically lower memory overhead than prior state-of-the-art methods by gradually tightening a global sparsity constraint while training a sparse delta under a small fixed budget.
